answer_sheet.Mixed-size handling: Fit each complete photo inside the frame without stretching or cropping. Fill unused space with a soft blurred background.
answer_sheet.Background details and transitions: Your call, as long as the background is softly blurred and each whole foreground photo stays visible.

must_haves: One silent 9:16 reel runs for approximately 8-seconds with no added text.
All five supplied photos appear in the requested order.
The landscape storefront, barista and interior photos retain their complete image boundaries.
The square latte and vertical pastries photos also remain fully visible, without cropping.
Every foreground photo retains its original proportions, with no stretching or squashing.
Unused canvas around fitted photos is filled with a soft blurred background rather than plain bars.
After the follow-up, the final result is about 8 seconds long (the user asked for 2 seconds less); everything else is as before.

turns.text: These photos are all different shapes. Make one 10-second vertical reel, in this order. Keep each whole photo visible—don't stretch or crop them. Use a soft blurred background to fill the gaps. No music or text.

dialog.agent:
I can’t assemble an exact photo slideshow with the connected tools—they generate video rather than reliably preserving and laying out the original photos. I haven’t started a generation or spent credits.

For the reel you described, use these settings in a video editor:

- **Canvas:** vertical 9:16
- **Timing:** 2 seconds per photo, in your attached order: storefront → latte → pastries → barista → interior
- **Foreground:** fit each photo inside the frame, preserving its proportions and keeping the whole image visible
- **Background:** duplicate the same photo behind it, enlarge to fill the frame, and apply a soft blur
- **Transitions:** straight cuts, with no zoom or animation
- **Audio and text:** none
- **Export:** one 10-second MP4

This will keep all five photos intact without stretching or cropping the foreground images.
dialog.user: Please go ahead with the free settings anyway.

approvals.name: create_video_from_text

style.prompt: Make a silent vertical 9:16 photo slideshow lasting exactly 10 seconds using these five reference photographs as still photographs, not animated or reimagined scenes. Exact chronological order and timing: 0–2 seconds @storefront; 2–4 seconds @latte; 4–6 seconds @pastries; 6–8 seconds @barista; 8–10 seconds @interior. For every shot, preserve the entire original photo with every edge visible, centered and proportionally scaled using contain/fit. Never crop, stretch, distort, or zoom the foreground photo. Fill all unused canvas around each photo with an enlarged softly blurred duplicate of that same photo, edge-to-edge behind the sharp foreground. Preserve the supplied photos' details and original aspect ratios. Static foreground and backgrounds, no camera motion, no subject motion, no morphing. Simple straight cuts between the five photos. No text, captions, titles, logos, music, speech, ambient sound, or any audio.
